statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail is 21%, inside the watch band and below the block threshold.
recommendation: Conditions describe an orderly trend-up session that has just extended to a new high, so the Nasdaq-100 is trading close to its session extreme with the Cleveland Fed speech at 19:00Z and the 20:00Z cash close as the near checkpoints. Retracement has stayed available through the afternoon, including an hour-long consolidation earlier, so the mapped state remains below the block threshold. The narrow danger window is unchanged: the 12:30-14:00Z August employment report on 4 September.
headline: Nasdaq-100 grinds to a new session high near 29,539 as VIX slips to 14.5 and Broadcom pares its post-earnings loss
body: The Nasdaq-100 trades at 29,527 (+1.32%) inside a 29,160.96-29,538.76 session range, having printed that high within the last hour and settling about 11 points beneath it. The advance is a grind rather than an impulse: the index spent roughly an hour consolidating some 50 points below the earlier 29,494 high before extending, so meaningful retracement has been available throughout the afternoon. VIX is 14.52, down 4.5% and close to its 14.47 session low, while the 2-year yield is 4.34% and the 10-year 4.76%, both lower after Fed Governor Waller argued for patience and signalled he could support holding the policy rate steady this month. Today's data was supportive: ISM Services beat at 55.4, initial jobless claims printed 206K, and Challenger reported 52,881 August job cuts, the lowest August total in four years. Internals stay split rather than aligned: software leads while semiconductors lag, though Broadcom has pared its post-earnings decline to about 3% from a 5% low, and Tesla is firm into tonight's Cybercab launch event. Cross-asset confirmation is partial. WTI is near $91 after a $93.14 high, with the Middle East story unresolved, gold is sharply higher and Treasuries are bid. Trade near the session extreme into the power hour, with a Cleveland Fed speech scheduled at 19:00Z, lifts Tail back into the watch band, while decaying volatility, lagging semiconductors and available pullbacks keep it well below the block threshold. Stress stays elevated on the oil backdrop and tomorrow's payrolls binary.

lookbackSummary: Across the past 24 hours the published state was green for 18 of the 20 assessed hours, with Tail between 11% and 15% through the overnight and European sessions as Stress eased into the low 50s. The US morning repriced yields after the Waller remarks and the ISM Services beat, and the state moved to yellow at 15:00Z and 16:00Z with Tail at 21% and 20% while the index sat at its session extreme, then back to green at 17:00Z with Tail 19% during an hour of consolidation. Four hours have no published assessment and are marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The near path keeps Tail in the watch band for the current hour and the 19:00Z Cleveland Fed speech, because the index is trading close to its session extreme during the power hour, then eases back into the low band around the 20:00Z cash close if no late one-way extension appears. Risk is projected to decay through the evening and the Asian session, with the Tesla Cybercab launch treated as a contained single-name catalyst, then to rebuild gradually through European hours into the August employment report at 12:30Z on 4 September, which is the mapped danger window. Tail is deliberately capped at the top of the watch band across that release and the delayed second-leg hour, because event magnitude and forecast dispersion raise Stress and lower Confidence rather than establishing a no-retracement price path.

forecast.analysis: A scheduled Cleveland Fed speech at 19:00Z lands inside the power-hour window while the index sits near its session extreme. Hammack has argued for acting on rate rises, a counterpoint to the Waller remarks that drove today's yield decline, so the hour is treated as a conditional two-way repricing checkpoint rather than an observed continuation.

forecast.analysis: The 20:00Z US cash close and closing-auction flows fall in this hour. If the session ends without a fresh one-way extension, realised volatility usually decays into the post-close window and Tail eases back into the low band. A close pinned on the session high would instead keep the near-extreme condition intact.

Invalidation: a close pinned on the session high

forecast.analysis: Post-close liquidity thins and NQ futures take over price discovery. Tesla's scheduled Cybercab launch event in Austin is the evening's single-name catalyst; Tesla carries index weight, so a sharp reaction can reach NQ, but a single-stock repricing rarely produces the persistent index-level path that Tail measures.

Tail is projected near the lower end of the low band on the assumption that no new catalyst arrives; the residual risk is a geopolitical or corporate headline printed while depth is at its thinnest.

Any material change would have to come from an Asian macro print or an overnight geopolitical development, neither of which is observed at the cutoff.
